title_en: C3 crossover on the in-universe score (companion to C3, amendment A15)
title_zh: C3 交叉样本量：候选集内得分版（C3 的配套，修订 A15）
reading_en: Counting only relevant items a model can reach (inside the 1,500-item candidate universe), N* exists at k=all in 6 of 7 datasets (standard score: 5) and at k=10 in 3 (standard: 3). Series whose answer changes: amazon-video-games/k=all. This shows how much of the 'popularity wins' result is the candidate cap talking.
reading_zh: 只统计模型够得着的相关物品（候选集 1,500 个物品之内）时，k=all 下 7 个数据集中 6 个存在 N*（标准得分：5 个），k=10 下 3 个（标准：3 个）。结果发生变化的序列：amazon-video-games/k=all。这说明'热门更好'的结果有多少是候选集上限造成的。
rule: Same N* rule as C3 (A12) on U_ndcg_in; companion, not a registered verdict.

title_en: Where does the crossover really start? C3 with the grid extended down to N=20
title_zh: 交叉点到底从哪里开始？把 C3 的网格向下延伸到 N=20
reading_en: With three smaller sample sizes added (20, 40, 60 people), the crossover at k=all moves below 100 in 3 datasets; ml-latest: <= 20 (smallest tested); ml-1m: 100; amazon-video-games: none (> 2000); amazon-musical-instruments: none (> 2000); amazon-software: <= 20 (smallest tested); kuairand-pure: <= 20 (smallest tested); gowalla: 1000.
reading_zh: 加入三个更小的样本量（20、40、60 人）后，k=all 时交叉点移到 100 以下的数据集有 3 个；ml-latest：<= 20 (smallest tested)；ml-1m：100；amazon-video-games：none (> 2000)；amazon-musical-instruments：none (> 2000)；amazon-software：<= 20 (smallest tested)；kuairand-pure：<= 20 (smallest tested)；gowalla：1000。
rule: N* as in A12, on the grid {20, 40, 60} + the registered grid; exploratory.
